polemical_milestones.work: Sefer Milhamot Hashem (The Wars of the Lord)
polemical_milestones.author: Jacob ben Reuben
polemical_milestones.content: Systematic critique of the Gospels, identifying chronological errors and misapplied prophetic verses.

polemical_milestones.protagonists: Rabbi Moses ben Nachman (Nachmanides / Ramban) vs Pablo Christiani
polemical_milestones.outcome: Nachmanides successfully argued before King James I of Aragon that Aggadic Midrashim are non-binding homilies, and that the Messiah has not yet come because world peace and end of war have manifestly not arrived.

polemical_milestones.author: Isaac ben Abraham of Troki
polemical_milestones.content: Comprehensive 50-chapter polemic dissecting New Testament contradictions, demonstrating the perpetuity of the Mosaic Law, and analyzing all Christian Christological proof-texts.
